result.instructions: Tools for Invoiced, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are past due, and how much does each customer owe?"; "What is Acme Ltd's current outstanding balance?"; "List the payments we received this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Invoiced data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run invoiced_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run invoiced_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run invoiced_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. invoiced_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: invoiced_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (accounts receivable debtors): name, number, email, payment terms, currency, autopay and chasing settings, owner. Filter by open balance, saved payment method, update time or any exact-match column. GET /customers.

open_balance.description: true = only customers with an open balance; false = only those without.

payment_source.description: true = only customers with a saved payment method.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this date or date-time.

filter.description: Exact-match filters on object columns, e.g. {"paid": false, "currency": "usd"}. Booleans are sent as 1/0.

metadata.description: Exact-match filters on metadata keys, e.g. {"account-rep": "Jan"}.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invoiced_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact details, address, terms, currency, autopay, chasing cadence, credit hold/limit, parent customer, metadata. GET /customers/{id}.

customer_id.description: Invoiced customer id (numeric; not the customer number).

tools.name: invoiced_get_customer_balance
tools.title: Get customer balance
tools.description: A customer's current balance: total outstanding, past due, and available credit, in the customer's currency (or `currency`). GET /customers/{id}/balance.

tools.name: invoiced_list_contacts
tools.title: List customer contacts
tools.description: List the contacts of one customer: name, title, email, phone, whether primary (copied on communications) and SMS-enabled. GET /customers/{id}/contacts.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invoiced_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with number, customer, status (draft, not_sent, sent, viewed, past_due, pending, paid, voided), dates, totals, balance and line items. Filter by customer, paid flag, invoice date range, update time or any exact-match column. GET /invoices.

paid.description: true = only paid invoices; false = only unpaid.

start_date.description: Invoices dated on or after this date or date-time.

end_date.description: Invoices dated on or before this date (a bare date includes the whole day).

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this date or date-time.

filter.description: Exact-match filters on object columns, e.g. {"paid": false, "currency": "usd"}. Booleans are sent as 1/0.

metadata.description: Exact-match filters on metadata keys, e.g. {"account-rep": "Jan"}.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invoiced_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by id: status, dates, payment terms, totals, balance, line items, discounts, taxes, ship-to, payment and PDF links. `expand` replaces ids with full objects (e.g. customer). GET /invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: Invoiced invoice id (numeric; find it with invoiced_list_invoices).

expand.description: Relations to expand into full objects.

tools.name: invoiced_get_invoice_payment_plan
tools.title: Get invoice payment plan
tools.description: The payment plan (installments with dates, amounts and balances, and approval status) attached to an invoice. Errors with 404 when the invoice has none. GET /invoices/{id}/payment_plan.

tools.title: List payments

end_date.description: Payments dated on or before this date (a bare date includes the whole day).

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this date or date-time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: invoiced_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in Invoiced. Nothing is sent to anyone and no money moves. Name is required; Invoiced generates the customer number unless given. POST /customers.

metadata.description: Metadata key/values (max 10 keys, names up to 40 characters, values up to 255).

tools.name: invoiced_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice for a customer. It is always created as a draft: it is not issued, not emailed, not charged and cannot trigger AutoPay until a person finalizes it in Invoiced. At least one line item is required. POST /invoices with draft=true.

name.description: Line item name (required unless catalog_item is given).

catalog_item.description: Id of an item in the catalog (invoiced_list_items); fills the name and price.

unit_cost.description: Price per unit, in the invoice currency.

due_date.description: Due date (default: computed from the payment terms).

metadata.description: Metadata key/values (max 10 keys, names up to 40 characters, values up to 255).

tools.name: invoiced_add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a customer or an invoice (give exactly one). Notes are internal; nothing is sent. POST /notes.

customer_id.description: Customer to attach the note to.

invoice_id.description: Invoice to attach the note to.

tools.name: invoiced_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a collection task for a customer (a reminder to call, write, email or review). Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /tasks.

name.description: Task name, e.g. "Call about overdue invoice".

user_id.description: Invoiced user to assign it to.
